display.explanation: At the beginning of the civil year, give thanks for God’s faithfulness and pray for renewal in the days ahead.
display.prompt: Pray for courage, hope and openness to God as the new year begins.

sentences.label: Sentence
sentences.text: There is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given among us by which we must be saved. Acts 4:12

collects.text:
Eternal God,
to whom a thousand years are no more than a moment;
renew us in your Holy Spirit,
so that we may serve you with courage
while we have life and breath;
through the grace of Jesus your Son our Saviour.
Amen.

God of time and eternity,
as we enter this new year
day by day
open us to your new age.
Hear this prayer for your love's sake.
Amen.

God of time and eternity,
as we enter this new year
day by day
open us to your new age.
